$schemaDescription: Single source of truth for the BLE notifications sent by moto-connectivity-node to moto-mobile: the telemetry packet (current version 3, top level), its low-MTU fallback (the version 2 layout) and the IMU sample block. Implementations: src/BLETelemetryPacket.h and src/ImuBlockPacket.h (firmware), moto-mobile lib/models/telemetry_data.dart and lib/models/imu_block.dart (decoders, with a copy of this file under test/fixtures/ checked by a test), and moto-server (decodes raw_hex/imu raw bytes driven by this file). Ported from HondaCl250_Telemetry@legacy-final (version 1) per D-023; version 3 and the IMU block per D-032.

telemetry.carries: BLETelemetryPacket (version 3, or version 2 at low MTU)

telematicsRx.carries: Phone telematics text (not part of this schema)

mtu.rule: The central requests an ATT MTU of at least `requested` right after connecting (Android: requestMtu; iOS negotiates on its own). The firmware reads the negotiated MTU and never sends a notification larger than MTU - 3 bytes: it falls back to the version 2 telemetry layout (`lowMtuFallback`) and shrinks or suspends IMU blocks (`imuBlock.mtuRule`). It never truncates a packet.

signalMapping: A field with `defsSignal` carries that moto-vehicle-defs signal (gen/python vehicle_cl250.DIDS key); physical value in the defs unit = raw * `scale`. A field with `ageOf` is the age of that signal.

versioning.rule: Receivers MUST read `version` first and decode with the matching layout: version 3 (`fields`) or version 2 (`lowMtuFallback.fields`). Any other version is dropped. Any change to field order, size or meaning requires incrementing `version` here and in every implementation together.

history.1: Legacy layout (15 bytes). Lean fields came from the dropped complementary filter.
history.2: Lean fields keep their offsets but carry `notAvailable` until the rt-core EKF lean estimate reaches this node (D-023); byte 15 `flags` added so receivers can show stale values as unavailable.
history.3: D-032: adds `deviceTimeMs` (node clock shared with the IMU block), per-signal ages and CAN/tester health; flags bit 7 = imuActive; lean fields deprecated. Version 2 remains the low-MTU fallback.

sequenceNumber.rule: Rolls over 0-255 and is shared by version 2 and version 3 packets. Receivers track the last seen seq and compute (currentSeq - lastSeq - 1) mod 256 as the number of packets lost since the previous one.

deviceTime.rule: The node's millis() clock when the packet was built (uint32, wraps after about 49.7 days). The IMU block uses the same clock, so telemetry and IMU samples can be aligned without the phone's receive time.

notAvailable.rule: A lean field equal to -32768 (0x8000) means no value is available; receivers must not display it as a number.

age.rule: Milliseconds since the signal was last written, at the time the packet was built, saturating at `max`; `neverReceived` = no value since boot. The matching valid bit is set only while the age is within the signal's generated stale_after_ms (moto-vehicle-defs, D-029).

flags.rule: A value whose valid bit is 0 is stale or was never received; receivers show it as unavailable instead of the number.

bits.name: imuActive
bits.description: The IMU sampler is running and its last read succeeded. Version 2 packets always send 0 here.

values.name: notInstalled
values.description: No TWAI driver in this build (poller off, D-021) or synthetic data (mock build).

values.name: errorWarning
values.description: TEC or REC at or above the error-warning limit (96).

values.name: stopped
values.description: Driver stopped: recovering from bus-off, or latched off (see canFlags).

bits.name: pollerEnabled
bits.description: This build is the vehicle-bus tester (CONN_VEHICLE_TESTER=1, D-023).

bits.name: latchedForeignTester
bits.description: Poller stopped until reboot: another tester was seen (D-021, D-030).

bits.name: latchedBusOff
bits.description: Poller stopped until reboot: repeated bus-off (D-030).

bits.name: syntheticData
bits.description: Mock build: engine values are simulated, not from the ECU.

canHealth.counterRule: Error counters saturate at 255, busOffCount at 255 and unansweredDidCount at 65535. Counters are cumulative since boot and freeze when the poller latches off.

deprecated.rule: Deprecated -- do not use for analysis (D-023). Always `notAvailable`; kept only so the layout stays close to version 2. Lean comes from the rt-core EKF later.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Packet format version, 3.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Rolling 0-255 counter incremented once per telemetry packet sent (any version).

fields.name: deviceTimeMs
fields.description: Node clock in ms when the packet was built, see `deviceTime`.

fields.name: rpm
fields.description: Engine speed in rpm (integer part), range 0-16383.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Vehicle speed in km/h, range 0-255.

fields.name: coolantTemp
fields.description: Coolant temperature in degrees Celsius, range -40 to 127 (higher values are clamped to 127).

fields.name: throttlePos
fields.description: Throttle position in percent, range 0-100.

fields.name: batteryVolt
fields.description: Battery voltage in millivolts, e.g. 12400 = 12.4 V.

fields.name: leanAngle
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). Always -32768.

fields.name: maxLeanRight
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). Always -32768.

fields.name: maxLeanLeft
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). Always -32768.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Validity bits, see `flags`.

fields.name: rpmAgeMs
fields.description: Age of rpm, see `age`.

fields.name: speedAgeMs
fields.description: Age of speed, see `age`.

fields.name: coolantTempAgeMs
fields.description: Age of coolantTemp, see `age`.

fields.name: throttlePosAgeMs
fields.description: Age of throttlePos, see `age`.

fields.name: batteryVoltAgeMs
fields.description: Age of batteryVolt, see `age`.

fields.name: canBusState
fields.description: Vehicle-bus TWAI state, see `canHealth.busState`.

fields.name: canTxErrorCount
fields.description: TWAI transmit error counter (TEC), saturating at 255.

fields.name: canRxErrorCount
fields.description: TWAI receive error counter (REC), saturating at 255.

fields.name: canBusOffCount
fields.description: Bus-off events since boot, saturating at 255.

fields.name: unansweredDidCount
fields.description: UDS DID requests that timed out without any response since boot, saturating at 65535.

fields.name: canFlags
fields.description: Tester/poller status bits, see `canHealth.canFlags`.

lowMtuFallback.rule: When the negotiated MTU - 3 is smaller than `totalBytes` (37), the firmware sends this version 2 layout instead (16 bytes, fits the default MTU of 23). Receivers that see version 2 from a version 3 firmware should request a larger MTU; receivers that only ever see version 2 are talking to old firmware and should recommend a firmware update.
lowMtuFallback.flagsRule: Same bits as `flags`, except bit 7 is always 0.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Packet format version, 2.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Same counter as version 3 `seq`.

fields.name: rpm
fields.description: Engine speed in rpm (integer part), range 0-16383.

fields.name: speed
fields.description: Vehicle speed in km/h, range 0-255.

fields.name: coolantTemp
fields.description: Coolant temperature in degrees Celsius, range -40 to 127.

fields.name: throttlePos
fields.description: Throttle position in percent, range 0-100.

fields.name: batteryVolt
fields.description: Battery voltage in millivolts.

fields.name: leanAngle
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). -32768 = not available.

fields.name: maxLeanRight
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). -32768 = not available.

fields.name: maxLeanLeft
fields.description: DEPRECATED, do not use for analysis (D-023). -32768 = not available.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Validity bits, see `flags`.

sensor.sampling: 100 Hz, driven by a hardware timer on the node; sample n is taken at the n-th timer tick. The node verifies the sensor configuration once per second and configures it again when it was lost (flag sensorReconfigured).
sensor.axes: Sensor package frame (x, y, z as printed on the part). The mapping to the vehicle frame depends on the mount and must be recorded in the session note until the mount is fixed.

sampleIndex.rule: Running 100 Hz tick counter (uint16, wraps). Samples inside one block are always consecutive ticks. Receivers compute missingSamples = (firstSampleIndex - (prev.firstSampleIndex + prev.sampleCount)) mod 65536 for every block after the first; this counts samples lost on the node (buffer overflow, read error, missed tick) and in BLE together.

imuBlock.timeRule: Sample i of a block (0-based) was taken at deviceTimeMs + i * samplePeriodMs on the same clock as the telemetry `deviceTimeMs`.
imuBlock.mtuRule: samplesPerBlock = min(maxSamples, floor((MTU - 3 - headerBytes) / sampleBytes)). If that is 0 (e.g. the default MTU of 23), IMU notifications are suspended and the lost samples show up as a firstSampleIndex gap later. At most 3 blocks are sent per notify period, so a small MTU lowers the delivered rate instead of delaying the node.

bits.name: deviceOverflow
bits.description: The node's sample ring buffer was full at least once since the previous block; the oldest unsent samples were kept and new ones dropped.

bits.name: readError
bits.description: At least one sensor read failed since the previous block.

bits.name: sensorReconfigured
bits.description: The node found the sensor configuration lost (e.g. a brown-out reset it to its defaults) or reads failing, and configured it again since the previous block. Samples before this block may be in the wrong scale or frozen.

headerFields.name: seq
headerFields.description: Rolling 0-255 counter incremented once per IMU block sent.

headerFields.name: deviceTimeMs
headerFields.description: Node clock in ms when the first sample of the block was taken.

headerFields.name: firstSampleIndex
headerFields.description: Tick index of the first sample, see `sampleIndex`.
